about.title: About SANGAM
about.body: SANGAM is a community innovation network for SIH26043. It helps citizens report societal problems and connects them with universities and industry partners who can collaborate on solutions. AI makes SANGAM easier to use — it is not the product itself.
about.privacy: We minimize personal data. Public summaries never expose private citizen details.
about.honesty: Demo organizations and journeys are labeled DEMO DATA. No fake partnerships or statistics.
